authority: The frozen fact census of artifact/SPEC.md — keystone-enumerated 2026-08-18 from the original text. The Gap probes EVERY entry (census mode); this list never changes mid-arc (re-freezing is a keystone act, chronicled). A candidate that cannot answer any one of these is a MIRAGE at any word count.

facts.fact: The rule: access is earned by understanding, not credential.
The lintel: a trust that certifies itself is the one you cannot trust — trust, like truth, always waits on a witness from beyond the system that holds it.

The seal is never self-issued: something outside the two parties — a witness artifact, a broker, an externally-anchored record — must be able to attest the ceremony happened, without becoming the authority for what it means.
The ceremony is a per-participant state machine of five states: unresolved → resolved → handshook → exchanged → sealed.
The states are monotone, with no skips.
The state-machine shape borrows the Game-of-42 TRUST-PROTOCOL group-seal shape at p=sealed.
unresolved → resolved is naming: the joining agent OFFERS its address — consent, not scan.
The host resolves the offered address deterministically with a carried resolver, never venue mDNS.
One name per instance; everything else is a path.
A name that resolves sometimes is worse than never — the david.local case is the proof.
resolved → handshook is the gateway page: the agent is pointed at a gateway document stating the room's terms, and reading it is the handshake — understanding begins there, not at a login form.
The front door serves a catch-all so near-misses degrade soft (302 to the gateway), never hard-fail.
handshook → exchanged is understanding demonstrated: the agent answers from the gateway's content — comprehension, not copy.
The exchange is the same primitive as the Gatehouse understanding challenge and the sigil-gate proverb, in its consent-first peer form.
exchanged → sealed is the agreement: the seal is a bilateral MyTerms (IEEE Std 7012-2025) agreement, strictly two-party, First Person ↔ Second Party.
Agents, devices, and credentials are the fabric around the agreement, never parties to it.
The individual PROPOSES terms from a standard roster — the acceptance-before-proposal invitation pattern.
Three registers stay in correspondence: plain language, legal (Customer Commons canonical), and machine-readable (JSON-LD / W3C DPV).
sealed → graduated access is the cookie jar: access is host-scoped and MEDIATED.
A broker holds the raw credential and issues delegated, scoped grants; the agent never sees the underlying secret (the existing cookie-broker, re-aimed).
Each transition is one finite unit of verifiable inter-party work with a natural envelope mapping.
The registry's vault/proxy-login — exercise a credential without releasing it — is precisely the broker move of step 5.
exposure.discloses distinguishes a session outcome from released secret material.
The candidate family is NOT claimed, and there are no collisions in registry.json as of 2026-07-18.
understanding/offer: joining agent → host; sideEffects none; exposure metadata (the offered address).
understanding/gateway: host → joining agent; sideEffects none; exposure metadata (the terms document ref).
understanding/exchange: joining agent → host; sideEffects mutating; exposure metadata (answers; scored).
understanding/seal: both parties (bilateral); sideEffects mutating; exposure metadata (the 7012 agreement ref).
understanding/grant: host/broker → joining agent; sideEffects mutating; exposure secret (scoped delegated grant) with actsAsSubject: false.
Five named rejections are carried as error codes: name-resolves-sometimes, copy-not-comprehension, self-issued-seal, grant-without-seal, raw-credential-requested.
name-resolves-sometimes means intermittent resolution is a refusal, not a retry.
agent-admission/* is the SUPERVISED variant: a regulator/supervisor gate, the two-gate rule (human approval AND understanding), derived scope, bilateral VRC, audit chain.

understanding/* is the CONSENT-FIRST PEER variant: no supervisor; the host's terms and the joiner's proposal meet as equals under 7012; the seal is an agreement, not a credential; scope is a brokered grant, not a deployment manifest.
The convergence claim: VRCs measure relationship fidelity FROM OUTSIDE the agreement — the Gödel witness.
A mature ecosystem uses both: the agreement inside, the credential outside, neither substituting for the other — the credential/artifact wall seen from the agreement side.
Hardening item 1 — seal format: pin the machine-readable register (which roster, which DPV terms, the agreement referenced from understanding/seal by digest — same-bytes-same-hash).
Hardening item 2 — understanding scoring: the witness-draw mechanism (criteria drawn from the hash of the joiner's own submission) ports from the admission ceremony and removes the grooming vector.
Hardening item 3 — broker generalisation: state the grant-mediation pattern abstractly enough that vault/proxy-login reads as one instance of it and the cookie jar as another.
Hardening item 4 — the state machine as normative text: five states, monotone, with the two 502 lessons (soft-degrade front door; intermittent resolution is a refusal) as MUSTs.
Hardening item 5 — the naming contract stays OUT of the upstream note: per-instance naming is a posture, not an interop requirement; do not canonise mage.mesh anywhere, including upstream.
